summary: A plain Bootstrap one-pager on GitHub Pages for an open-source family commissioned for the City of Jakarta's '+Jakarta City of Collaboration' branding: black wordmark hero, short about text, a red tester whose default text lists the city's brand colours, a hairline character map and a download section with credits, OFL, contribution notes and a changelog. A civic commission presented with minimal design; the brand context (city colours, branding agency credit) does the storytelling.

instances.look: Fixed black top bar (HTML only, stitched over every crop): white '+j' dotted logo at the left, smooth-scroll links About Fonts · Type Tester · Characters · Download at the right; collapses to a hamburger on mobile
Full black screen, mostly empty; at the lower left '+Jakarta Sans' in white Display Medium (~144px) and under it, indented to the 'J', 'Open-source Fonts for Jakarta City of Collaboration' (~32px)
instances.ux: No CTA in the hero; the fixed nav carries Download
instances.learn: The '+' prefix of the city brand becomes part of the wordmark: a commissioned font can carry the client's identity device in its own name

reconstruction.typography: Name ~144px Plus Jakarta Display Medium, white, tight tracking; subtitle ~32px Plus Jakarta Text Regular, white

instances.learn: State the commission and the Display/Text split in one paragraph: who it's for, and why there are two optical families

instances.look: A full-width red-orange panel: a row of four white controls (style dropdown 'Plus Jakarta Display Medium', and Font Size, Line Height, Letter Spacing sliders drawn as white bars with a dark square thumb and the label inside), a big white editable sample 'Hijau Betawi / Jingga Bis Kota / Kuning Gigi Balang / Biru Abang / Pink None & City Collaboration.', and three white feature buttons 'Lancip Alternates: SS01', 'Lurus Alternates: SS02', 'Lingkar Alternates: SS03'
instances.ux: Pick any of 14 styles (Display and Text, roman and italic); drag size 10–120 (default 80), line height 30–300% (150), letter spacing −10…20 (0); type over the sample; toggle the three named stylistic sets (all on by default)
instances.learn: Use the client's brand vocabulary as default text (the city's named colours: Betawi green, city-bus orange, Abang blue) and give stylistic sets local names (Lancip = pointed, Lurus = straight, Lingkar = round)

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed ~830px, background #fe331b; container ~1340px: control row of 4 equal boxes (~315×38px, 30px gaps); sample block below (~3 lines at 80px/150%); feature row of 3 equal white bars (~430×38px) at the bottom
reconstruction.typography: Sample 80px Plus Jakarta Display Medium white, line-height 150%; control labels ~11px Plus Jakarta Text Regular grey inside the white boxes; feature labels ~12px centred
reconstruction.behaviour: select#fontFamilySelector onchange=changeFont() swaps font-family; input#fontsize (10–120), #lineheight (30–300), #spacing (−10–20 step .1) oninput=updateSlider() set font-size, line-height and letter-spacing; checkboxes .otFeature ss01/ss02/ss03 onchange=updateFeatures() build font-feature-settings

instances.look: 'Characters Map' then 259 glyphs in a 20-column grid of square cells with light grey hairlines: Latin caps and lowercase with accents, figures, inferiors and superiors, fractions, punctuation, currency, maths and symbols
instances.learn: A hairline square grid is the minimum viable character map: no interaction needed when the set is small
